fix: 'nervation/nervure(s) + quality' says the quality of the venation, not of the leaf. Bind 'nervation' to the venation class, not to the heading 'Feuilles'. 'sur les deux faces' (on both faces) is a place slot that should be kept.
reason: What is clearly visible is the venation, not the leaf as a whole.
'peduncle 3-5 mm': the length of the peduncle is 3-5 mm.
The stems are shortly pubescent. 'shortly' (a degree) is lost, which is acceptable.

target: towards: floral disc (FLOPO_0986025), at its base
fix: In 'inserted at the base of the X', the target is X (the disc), with 'base' as the position on it. 'base' alone is not the target.
reason: The filament is inserted at the base of the disc. The towards slot keeps only the generic 'base' (FLOPO_0985024) and loses the disc.

target: petal absent (usual state) + sometimes present, count 1(-5), obsolescent
fix: In 'X absent, sometimes N', 'sometimes' qualifies the presence that follows, not the absence. The usual state is absence. Add a separate statement: present, sometimes, count 1-5.
reason: The annotation reads 'petals sometimes absent'. The flora says petals are usually absent and only sometimes 1-5 (obsolescent).

target: confluent with (PATO_0002512), at apex; whole: sepal
fix: 'veins confluent at apex' means the veins run together and merge at the apex. Use the relational 'confluent with', not 'connate' (fusion of like organs), and keep the position 'at apex' and the whole (sepal).
reason: Confluent veins merge. They are not connate organs. The apical position and the sepal as the whole are also missing.

fix: With 'not Q + place-adverb', the negation applies only at that place. Keep the place slot (adaxially).
reason: The stigmas are said to be not lobed on the adaxial side. Without the place, 'stigma not lobed' claims more than the flora says.
'Flowers numerous': present, amount many.

fix: In 'Q1 or Q2 at the apex/base', the qualities belong to the apex/base of the blade. Substitute the apex part as the bearer.
reason: '± rounded or subacute at the apex' describes the blade apex, not the blade's overall shape (which is elliptic).
The leaves are alternate.
The fig's apex is ± umbonate. Umbonate already means having a boss at the apex, so a fruit bearer with the approximate qualifier is fine.
The galea is the upper corolla lip, and it is narrowly crested. Only 'narrowly' (a degree) is lost.
The leaflet blade is pubescent on the abaxial side. Substituting the abaxial epidermis with the leaflet lamina as the outer bearer matches the pattern.
Didymous means in two lobes, and the flora adds 'cleft to 1/2-2/3'. Bilobed fits.
The blades are glabrous above (adaxially), so the adaxial epidermis of the blade is the right bearer.
The bracts are shorter than the sepals.
'capitules nombreux': the capitula are present and many.
The calyx tube is adnate to the ovary, so 'fused with' the ovary. Using the calyx as the bearer for the calyx tube is acceptable.
The setae are pale brown to brownish: brown, approximate.

fix: When the description sits under 'terminal (leaflet): petiolule ..., blade ...', the blade is the leaflet blade, so the container should be the leaflet lamina.
reason: 13-20 teeth per side is correct, but they are on the terminal leaflet's blade, not on a leaf lamina.
'Calyx 5-lobed': 5 calyx lobes. 'almost to base' (the depth of division) is lost, which is acceptable.

fix: 'not seen' / 'unknown' / 'not known' state a gap in the material, not an absence. Do not annotate them as negated presence or quality.
reason: 'Female flowers not seen' does not say the flowers are not female or that female flowers are absent.
'Ovules shortly funiculate': a funicle is present (and short).
The stems are not julaceous.

fix: A place adverb at the start of a clause ('adaxially Q1 and Q2') covers every quality in it. Substitute the adaxial surface for all of them, as is done for 'abaxially'.
reason: The hispid and appressed-pubescent hairs are on the adaxial side. The place slot was dropped.
The inner sepals are obovate. FLOPO_0991378 = inner.

fix: In 'N cm broad/wide', 'broad' is the unit's dimension word and gives a width measurement, not the quality 'broad'.
reason: '4—10 cm. broad' is the leaf width. The leaves are not described as broad.

target: scale leaf (PO_0006003), at the base of the male catkin
fix: In 'scalelike leaflets at base' of a catkin, 'leaflets' means small leaves, not the leaflets of a compound leaf. Also keep the alternative 'or leaflets absent'.
reason: Salix catkins can have small scale-like leaves at the base. These are not compound-leaf leaflets (PO_0020049).

fix: In 'not Q at throat', the throat is the bearer (or a required place). Use the corolla throat class.
reason: Only the throat is said to lack a beard. The corolla as a whole is not described that way.
'membranous' follows the blade's apex, margin and base and describes the blade's texture.
